title: Groceries Transactions Data Set
scope: One month of real-world point-of-sale data from a typical local grocery outlet: 9,835 transactions and 169 aggregated item categories.
citation: Hahsler, M., Hornik, K., & Reutterer, T. (2006). Implications of probabilistic data modeling for mining association rules.
pedagogical_use: Private, restricted classroom use. The activity predicts a likely basket completion; it does not select a promotion or commercial intervention.
